summary: Split button with a primary action and a menu of alternatives; choosing an item rolls its label into the main button.

attributes.name: items
attributes.default: Deploy to production|Ships to everyone after checks;Deploy to staging|Internal testers only;Create preview|A unique URL for this branch;Schedule deploy…|Pick a time tonight
attributes.description: Menu entries separated by `;`, each `Label|Description` with an optional description; entries without a label are skipped. The first entry starts selected. Observed: a change rebuilds the menu and keeps the selection when its label is still there.

attributes.name: menu-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the caret button that opens the menu. Observed.

events.name: action
events.description: Fires when the main button is clicked. `value` is the selected item's label.

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when an item is chosen from the menu. `value` is its label.

methods.description: Opens or closes the menu: `true` opens, `false` closes, no argument toggles. Opening focuses the selected item.

keyboard.action: On the caret button: open the menu and focus the selected item.
In the menu: move focus to the next or previous item, wrapping.
In the menu: move focus to the first or last item.
In the menu: close it and return focus to the caret button.
In the menu: close it and move focus on.

accessibility: The caret button has `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and an `aria-label` from `menu-label`.
The menu has `role="menu"`; items are buttons with `role="menuitemradio"`, `aria-checked` on the current choice and `tabindex="-1"`.
Choosing an item closes the menu and returns focus to the caret button. A pointer press outside the element also closes the menu.
Effects are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, the button's drifting noise stops, menu rows appear without the sweep, the highlight jumps between rows and the label changes without rolling.
notes: The host carries an `open` attribute while the menu is open, usable for styling. Setting it yourself does not open the menu; call `toggle()`.
The menu is absolutely positioned below the button, up to 320px wide, and overlaps the content that follows.
The main button is at least 200px wide and 46px tall.
